label: The push stream: topics, heartbeat, reconnect

params.name: topics
params.label: Topic -> the name it travels under on the stream (the page reads the same names from bootstrap)

params.name: heartbeat_s
params.label: Seconds between heartbeats when there is no news (keeps proxies from closing the stream)

params.name: retry_ms
params.label: How long the browser waits before it reconnects (ms)

params.name: replay_keep
params.label: News kept for a page that reconnects (sent again after its Last-Event-ID)

description_nl: 2026-11-11 A20 (owner: out-perform the ten benchmark products): news comes down ONE stream per signed-in page (GET /api/core/events, core/events.py) - bell count, menu balloons, job progress. No page timer asks the server; the guard selfcheck_push.py fails a new one. Topic mcp (2026-11-12): the Connect your AI status line, sent when a key or AI sign-in is used, an app connects or disconnects, a key is made or revoked. Topic memory (CC 2026-11-12): a new Memory watch reading - sent only to open streams of people who may open Memory watch (key s:memory), never replayed; the page re-reads once per reading while Auto is on.
